notes.title: Echoes of the Past: The Final Attempt Begins
notes.content: [h1]Echoes of the Past[/h1][p]Now it’s clear before the island was cursed, it was a place of worship. [/p][p]A place mortals provided offerings seeking the blessing and trust from Tz'akabaak, the earth god, but as we know betrayal shattered that pact, and the spirit was trapped beneath the very altars built in his name. Through the years the temples crumbled down and the jungle took everything back. [/p][p]Now someone new has arrived. Henry is not the first to walk this path. Over the years, many historians, researchers and believers have tried to uncover the truth behind this island all driven by obsession, or purpose. Many inspired by  legends like David Livingstone, embark on this mission, however, the island doesn't take this intrusion lightly, only few can venture deep into the island and come back unharmed. The remnants of those who came before are still here: crumbled notebooks, shattered equipment and overgrown camps can be found throughout Dreadbone. The jungle keeps what it wants. [/p][p]One of them was Henry’s own grandfather. That’s the reason why he is here now, to uncover what happened to him, did the island capture him? He’s not just chasing myths he is following a trial that went cold decades ago, his family was on to something.[/p][p]Soon you'll be able to resolve this mystery yourself, enjoy this teaser of what's to come![/p][previewyoutube="yOlw5sE0zzE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s been such an amazing journey for the whole team, it’s been months since we started this project. From concepts and ideas to finally a concrete and finalized demo. The team has worked so hard and tirelessly through many long nights, truly showing their passion and commitment towards Dreadbone. There is still more to come, but for now let's enjoy this incredible success together! [/p][p][b]Progress Update:[/b] In this last few weeks we have been implementing an immaculate UI and a beautiful credit scene, the VFX and SFX teams have been fixing and refining effects, while the design department has been fixing bugs and trying non-stop our build. Finally and most important we have been working on improving the performance of the game, so that it runs smoothly on launch. Things are starting to look Ready! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/d2eda81d2d6677a7c894142c399a2022e34e3207.png"][/img]Once again, thanks for all the support. We will see you all on Friday on the demo launch, we are excited to read your comment and opinions about it! Will also release the trailer of Dreadbone on Friday, so get ready it's gonna be an amazing day full of surprises. Finally, don't forget to wishlist Dreadbone, right now to be the first ones to play the demo ;)[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587460/Dreadbone/"]Wishlist Dreadbone[/url] to uncover what the island has buried.[/p][p]📅 Demo drops July 11th[/p][p]🎬 Full Trailer lands this Friday[/p]

notes.title: Powers of the Awaken Spirit: Relic, Earthquake and Pollen
notes.content: [h1]The Spirit Stirs Again [/h1][p]Dreadbone isn't about a hero with a sword. It's about somethin older, something buried. [/p][p]You are [b]Tz'akabaak[/b], the Earth Spirit. Once worshipped across the Island, your body was sealed long ago. But not everything was lost. The temples crumbled. The Jungle grew wild. Yet deep below your power held on fractured, quiet and waiting. Now you're awake and even with what little remains of your strength, three forces still answer your call: [b]The Relic and the Earthquake and the Pollen. [/b][/p][h2]The Relic[/h2][p]The relics were once offerings. Statues used to connect with you when you were still a god. Now, they're how you reach out again. Remember you don't control Henry, but the relic lets you guide him. It reconnects broken paths, makes roads appear that were long forgotten. It will help you guide henry through the island, making him come closer to you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/dd0a0d4e243356c6a8ce29048028481eccb0c019.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The Earthquake [/h2][p]The island still listens, but only when you're in the right spot. In your spirit form, you can rise or lower the terrain at your will. You can open up new routes, block off danger or tear through what's in the way. It's not a spell, it's your old strength pushing though the cracked earth. As you can see with this mechanics on you side, your freedom get's closer and closer. Henry is on his way towards you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/192e489f22e84bd692154db3963815a3fc02e4ca.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The Pollen[/h2][p]Ancient trees once blessed by Tz'akabaak still remain, scattered across the island, quiet and reminiscing from an age when you ruled. Their roots run deep into sacred grounds, and the pollen carry the whispers of a forgotten god. You can still trigger this trees freezing enemies in place, clouding their senses and disabling their ability to attack. It's not just defense. It's a sign the jungle hasn't forgotten you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/559e592b46766e1af8d3bd4afce11f30a12ffd21.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The Island Responds[/h2][p]This is just the beginning. More powers are buried. More forces  will wake. But for now, these three are enough. The tools are in place and for the first time in a whole the path is starting to open. Dreadbone is changing and it knows you're back. [/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587460/Dreadbone/"]Wishlist Dreadbone[/url][b] and be the first to reshape the forgotten.[/b][/p][p]📅 [b]Demo drops July 11th — only one week left.[/b][/p]

tags.feature: You are [b]Tz'akabaak[/b], the Earth Spirit. Once worshipped across the Island, your body was sealed long ago. But not everything was lost. The temples crumbled. The Jungle grew wild. Yet deep below your power held on fractured, quiet and waiting. Now you're awake and even with what little remains of your strength, three forces still answer your call: [b]The Relic and the Earthquake and the Pollen. [/b]

The relics were once offerings. Statues used to connect with you when you were still a god. Now, they're how you reach out again. Remember you don't control Henry, but the relic lets you guide him. It reconnects broken paths, makes roads appear that were long forgotten. It will help you guide henry through the island, making him come closer to you.

The island still listens, but only when you're in the right spot. In your spirit form, you can rise or lower the terrain at your will. You can open up new routes, block off danger or tear through what's in the way. It's not a spell, it's your old strength pushing though the cracked earth. As you can see with this mechanics on you side, your freedom get's closer and closer. Henry is on his way towards you.

Ancient trees once blessed by Tz'akabaak still remain, scattered across the island, quiet and reminiscing from an age when you ruled. Their roots run deep into sacred grounds, and the pollen carry the whispers of a forgotten god. You can still trigger this trees freezing enemies in place, clouding their senses and disabling their ability to attack. It's not just defense. It's a sign the jungle hasn't forgotten you.

This is just the beginning. More powers are buried. More forces  will wake. But for now, these three are enough. The tools are in place and for the first time in a whole the path is starting to open. Dreadbone is changing and it knows you're back.
